    Payroll documents

    Hours pay comes from the Timesheet (approved hours on approved days, plus paid time off) up to the day before Assume worked from; the days from then to the end of the pay period are paid in advance at each person's hours per day. Next pay run suggests an adjustment if those days weren't worked. Bonus is in USD; for pesos write COP after the amount (for example -100000 COP). Click a name to change where they're paid from, their aportes, a fixed pay in pesos or their dollar rate.

    Saved pay runs

    Time off

    Approved time off for each person in the year (including what came from Connecteam). A full day counts as 1; time off by the hour counts its hours divided by the person's hours per day. Weekends inside a multi-day time off aren't counted. Click a person to see each date. Tick the boxes to export the day-by-day detail of those people.

    Updates

    Settings

    Hour rounding

    When hours are calculated (Timesheet, approvals, exports and My clock), each punch is rounded to the nearest step. The real punch times are kept exactly as they were.

    Location

    Each clock in, lunch and clock out saves where it was made (from the browser: GPS on phones, Wi‑Fi on computers). When it's required, the Time Clock won't record a punch until the agent shares their location.

    Test user

    Copy an agent's punches, approved days, requests and time off, documents and paystubs (with their files) to your test user — the test user also sees that agent's payment summary. Then sign in as the test user to see and try the agent view with real information. You can only copy to the test user (never a real agent); if it already has data you'll be warned, and copying replaces it. «Clear test user data» empties it when you're done. Whatever the test user had is replaced; the agent's own data isn't changed. The profile and the chat aren't copied. Test users show in the Timesheet with a TEST tag and are never included in the Pay run or the payroll exports.

    Automatic clock out

    For agents who forget to clock out. When an agent's worked time (lunch doesn't count) reaches their hours per day plus this margin, the Time Clock clocks them out at that exact time. The day is marked AUTO in the Timesheet with an alert so you can check it and correct it. Checked every 5 minutes.

    Lists

    The options users can be given in Users. Rename an option by editing it, remove it with ×, or add new ones. Removing an option doesn't change the users who already have it. Accounts come from the Monitor.

    Pay run

    The dollar is paid at the TRM of the payment day plus an amount, up to a maximum. These are the default values for each new pay run; you can still change them in a pay run. Rete ICA is withheld only from people paid from Nómina 247.

    Import from Connecteam

    Bring your hours history from Connecteam so it isn't lost. In Connecteam, export the Timesheet overview as Excel for the dates you want and upload that file here. You'll see a preview before anything is saved. Days that already have punches in the Time Clock are skipped, so importing the same dates twice doesn't duplicate anything.

    Users

    Agents sign in to the Time Clock with their email: add them here and they get an email to create their password. They only see their own Time Clock. Administrative staff are created in the portal.

    Equipment

    Import users from Connecteam

    In Connecteam open Users, show the columns you want to bring (email, phone, birthday, address, ID, bank…) and export the active list and the archived list. Choose both files here, check the list and confirm. Nobody is activated, and nothing that's already in the Time Clock changes: only empty data is filled in. Archived users stay inactive and marked «Archived». Connecteam doesn't export the ID type: choose it below and it's set for everyone who has an ID number and no type yet (you can import the same files again to complete it).

    Import documents from Connecteam

    Choose a ZIP made from Connecteam (connecteam_….zip): documents, Forms (Aportes and Cuentas de Cobro) or Payslips. Each file goes to that employee with its original date: documents with their status (approved, pending for you to review, or rejected), Forms to their month, and Payslips to their pay period. Former employees keep their files too. Files already imported are skipped, so you can run it again safely. Nothing that's already in Time Track changes, and a newer file uploaded here keeps counting.
